# Vero Beach Adult Medicine

> Adult primary care (internal medicine) in Vero Beach, Florida. Dr. Patricia Stewart, board-certified in internal medicine. No membership fee. Real time with your doctor. Same-day sick visits for registered patients. Currently accepting new adult patients.

Vero Beach Adult Medicine (VBAM) is a separate practice and brand from Vero Beach Pediatrics (https://verobeachpediatrics.com), which cares for children from newborns through the teen years. The two practices share an office phone number.

## Key facts
- Address: 955 37th Place, Vero Beach, FL 32960
- Phone: (772) 569-3212
- Physician: Dr. Patricia Stewart, board-certified internal medicine, 25+ years in private practice, particular expertise in women's health
- First visit: a new patient's first appointment is longer than a standard visit so Dr. Stewart can understand your full health picture.
- Cost: no membership fee. Most major insurance accepted; self-pay welcome. Plan list: https://verobeachadultmedicine.com/for-patients/#insurance
